learner_operation: Construct the augmented matrix, eliminate the second x coefficient, decide whether the last RHS is zero or nonzero, then select No solution or solve x in terms of free y. The consistency decision must depend on both equations, not on a source coefficient signature.

fixed_features.feature: Singular rank-one 2x2 coefficients with nonzero first x pivot
fixed_features.justification: The knowledge point and tutorial 3154 concern singular 2x2 systems; retaining a pivot avoids adding row-swap stages.

fixed_features.feature: x basic, y free; easy first x coefficient 1
fixed_features.justification: Matches all easy sources and tutorial 3153; one elimination and interpretation preserve easy workload.

fixed_features.feature: Five radio options with full vector families and No solution
fixed_features.justification: Every captured practice question uses this contract; none requests free-entry notation.
Conservative same-method extension. Each profile supports both residual decisions and signed/zero intercepts; profile no longer fixes which answer is correct.

counterfactuals.change: q-42157 seed7331, intercept2: second RHS -10 -> -8, with all coefficients, first equation and full ordered bank fixed.
counterfactuals.expected: No solution -> x=2+6y with y free; prompt, echelon row, explanation and native correct selection must all follow.
counterfactuals.observed: Independent equations and full bank math verify the change; native grader accepts each new correct choice and rejects all four alternatives; actual UI screenshots show both different prompts and solutions.
counterfactuals.justification: Tutorials 3901 and3154 make the eliminated RHS decisive; fixing its outcome by profile would bypass the learner operation.

counterfactuals.change: q-42157 seed7331, intercept2: second RHS -10 -> -5, so nonzero residual -2 becomes +3.
counterfactuals.expected: Both systems have No solution; prompt and elimination must update but response semantics remain the same.
counterfactuals.observed: Independent exact checks and native grader confirm No solution in both; screenshots001 and003 show updated RHS/residual and the same contradiction interpretation.
counterfactuals.justification: The sign or magnitude of a nonzero contradictory final RHS is irrelevant to solvability, by tutorial3901.
